command.civilization.status: Civilization %s is loaded. Calorie food system active. Use /civilization calories.

message.civilization.recovered: Energy recovered. Normal work and healing restored.
message.civilization.forage_start: Foraging: stay crouched and still for %s seconds.
message.civilization.forage_cancelled: Foraging interrupted. Crouch-right-click ground to try again.
message.civilization.forage_complete: Found a foraged morsel. Eat it to restore calories.

tooltip.civilization.ration: Three loaves packed into one ration. Same calories, less inventory space.
message.civilization.already_fertilized: This wheat is already fertilized. It will yield 3 wheat when mature.

tooltip.civilization.retort_fuel: Mineral Coal: 4 batches per piece. Burns continuously.
